segment.name: Commercial
segment.systems: PAS C (DB2: PROD_DEF / PROD_JURIS / PROD_VER) · Corporate rating engine · Per-program Excel raters (actuarial drive) · SOV & schedule workbooks · Forms library (ISO + manuscripts) · UW workbench
segment.operatingPattern: Account-underwritten package and monoline programs driven by SOV and unit-schedule workbooks, rated in the corporate engine with per-program Excel rater overrides, issued and endorsed in PAS C with release-note versioning.
segment.distribution: National and regional retail brokers; wholesale brokers for excess and non-admitted layers
segment.placement: Account-based: package policies plus monoline lines and layered towers sharing one underlying schedule
segment.reinsurance: Property per-risk XoL and casualty treaty; facultative on high-TIV locations and lead umbrellas
segment.regulatory: Admitted form/rate filings per state via SERFF; surplus lines placement and stamping-office compliance where layers are non-admitted

behavior.Product Taxonomy: Package structure (coverage parts under common declarations) defined in PAS C PROD_DEF; state availability rows in PROD_JURIS; each version cut as a PROD_VER row with release notes
behavior.Coverages: ISO CP/CG/CA/CU coverage parts plus company manuscript endorsements; grants attach per coverage part on the PAS C policy record
behavior.Terms: Limits and deductibles are driven off the SOV and unit schedules — blanket vs specific limits, cat percentage deductibles by peril and zone, per-unit-class fleet deductibles
behavior.Rating: Corporate rating engine holds class rates, loss costs and factors; large loss-rated accounts are overridden by per-program Excel raters on the actuarial shared drive
behavior.Pricing: TRIA/TRIPRA charges, state taxes and surcharges, and negotiated account deviations applied at bind; surplus lines tax and stamping fees on non-admitted layers
behavior.Underwriting Rules: Authority grids and referral rules live in the UW workbench; engineering-survey, cat-aggregation and underlying-schedule requirements are enforced pre-bind
behavior.Forms: ISO editions pulled from the electronic forms library plus company manuscript endorsements; attachment logic keyed by coverage part and state
behavior.Filings: Admitted forms and rates filed per state through SERFF with objection tracking; surplus lines layers are excluded from filing scope but tracked for stamping and diligent-search affidavits
behavior.Lifecycle Behavior: PAS C transactions end to end: mid-term SOV and schedule change endorsements, pro-rata unit adds/deletes, exposure audits at expiry, structured renewal cycles
